blocks.text: PASAY CITY–In a heartwarming display of love, unity, and international friendship, more than 5,300 delegates from 80 countries gathered at the SM Mall of Asia Arena on Friday for the three-day “Eternal Happiness” international convention of Jehovah’s Witnesses. The international visitors, many dressed in colorful traditional attire representing their respective cultures, joined some 20,000 Filipino delegates from different parts of the country for the gathering, making it one of the Philippines’ biggest international religious events this year.
